2026 General Election: Polling Place List

Posted on: October 14, 2026
Facebook opens in new windowTwitter opens in new windowEmail opens email clientPrint

We have confirmed polling places for 1,703 divisions. If any of these divisions need to be moved to another polling place, the proposed change will be brought before the Court of Common Pleas for approval.

The Polling Place list for the 2026 Municipal General Election can be downloaded by clicking below. Updated: 10/14/2026. Click to download: PDF | Excel
